title: 1938. Maximum Genetic Difference Query

examples.explanation: The queries are processed as follows: - [0,2]: The node with the maximum genetic difference is 0, with a difference of 2 XOR 0 = 2. - [3,2]: The node with the maximum genetic difference is 1, with a difference of 2 XOR 1 = 3. - [2,5]: The node with the maximum genetic difference is 2, with a difference of 5 XOR 2 = 7.
